mcqs.question: Which of the following statements correctly describes the angle‑sum relationship for a straight line?

options.A: The sum of two adjacent angles on a straight line is 180°
options.B: The sum of two vertically opposite angles is 180°
options.C: The sum of two adjacent angles is 90°
options.D: The sum of any two angles is 360°

mcqs.answer: The sum of two adjacent angles on a straight line is 180°
mcqs.explanation: Angles that share a common side and form a straight line are adjacent. Their measures always add up to 180°, the measure of a straight angle. Option B describes vertical angles, which are equal, not supplementary. Options C and D are incorrect statements about angle sums.

mcqs.question: Two intersecting lines form four angles. One of the angles measures 40° and its adjacent angle measures 70°. What is the measure of the angle opposite the 40° angle?
mcqs.explanation: When two lines intersect, opposite (vertically opposite) angles are equal. Hence the angle opposite the given 40° angle is also 40°. The 70° angle is adjacent to the 40° angle, and its opposite is also 70°. Options C and D are sums of angles, not the required opposite angle.

mcqs.question: Which pair of angles best fits the definition of adjacent angles?

options.A: Two angles that share a common vertex and a common side but do not overlap
options.B: Two angles that are opposite each other when two lines intersect
options.C: Two angles whose measures add up to 180° regardless of their position
options.D: Two angles that are formed by the same two lines and are equal in measure

mcqs.answer: Two angles that share a common vertex and a common side but do not overlap
mcqs.explanation: Adjacent angles are defined by sharing a vertex and a side while lying on opposite sides of the shared side, without overlapping. Option B describes vertically opposite angles. Option C describes supplementary angles, which may or may not be adjacent. Option D describes equal angles, not necessarily adjacent.

mcqs.question: If two angles are complementary and one of them measures 35°, what is the measure of the other angle?
mcqs.explanation: Complementary angles add up to 90°. Subtracting the known angle from 90° gives 90° − 35° = 55°. Options B, C, and D do not satisfy the complementary condition.

mcqs.question: Angles of 110° and ___ are supplementary. Which value correctly completes the statement?
mcqs.explanation: Supplementary angles sum to 180°. 180° − 110° = 70°, so the missing angle must be 70°. The other options give sums different from 180°.

mcqs.question: Two intersecting lines form four angles: 45°, 135°, and two unknown angles. Which statement is true about the unknown angles?

options.A: Each unknown angle is equal to the angle opposite it, i.e., the angle opposite 45° is also 45°
options.B: Each unknown angle is equal to the angle opposite it, i.e., the angle opposite 45° is 135°
options.D: The sum of each pair of opposite angles is 180°

mcqs.answer: Each unknown angle is equal to the angle opposite it, i.e., the angle opposite 45° is also 45°
mcqs.explanation: When two lines intersect, vertically opposite angles are equal. Hence the angle opposite the given 45° must also be 45°, and the angle opposite 135° must be 135°. Option B incorrectly swaps the measures. Option C would only be true for intersecting lines at right angles, which is not the case here. Option D describes supplementary angles, which are adjacent, not opposite.

mcqs.question: A common mistake is to think that the sum of any two adjacent angles is 360°. Which of the following statements correctly corrects this misconception?

options.A: The sum of two adjacent angles that form a straight line is 180°
options.B: The sum of any two angles, whether adjacent or not, is always 360°
options.C: Adjacent angles can have any sum depending on the figure
options.D: The sum of two vertically opposite angles is 180°

mcqs.answer: The sum of two adjacent angles that form a straight line is 180°
mcqs.explanation: Only when two adjacent angles lie on a straight line (forming a linear pair) do they sum to 180°. The statement in option B is false; only a full rotation of 360° involves all four angles around a point. Option C is too vague, and option D confuses vertical angles (which are equal) with supplementary angles.

mcqs.question: In a pair of intersecting lines, one angle is twice another, and the smaller angle measures 30°. What is the measure of the larger angle?
mcqs.explanation: Let the smaller angle be x = 30°. The larger angle is 2x = 60°. This satisfies the relationship given. Options B, C, and D do not correspond to twice 30°.
